schema.clock: Invocation to acceptance markers. A direction-file final write follows successful fixed-order line search and precedes outer state serialization. Startup is included in step 1.
schema.inner: Original file birth to final write encloses iteration records, excluding initial sampling and return overhead. Sequential calls: one fixed-trace journal per rematch and one accepted-trial journal per accepted update. Contiguous operation numbers show no additional rejected inner solves.
schema.other: All non-journalled work. Outer quadrature, determinant checks/projections and order/phase iterations had no individual clocks. Upper bounds overlap this category and must not be added to it.
schema.backtracks: Minimum counts are exact halvings in the successful harmonic pass. Earlier failed direction-refinement passes were overwritten, except in the final checkpoint. No extra full inner solve was launched for a rejected trial.
schema.residuals: Euclidean norm and largest component of the packed free active gradient. Pre is the accepted direction archive. Post includes any same-step field rematch. Immediate post-step infinity norms precede rematches. L2 at step 29 requires a separate saved-state gradient readout.
schema.energy: Fixed-field crystal-plus-gauge change equals the total change during that substep. The net change also includes any following same-step rematch. Re-anchored to logged float64 total energies at rematches.
schema.tail: Time after accepted step 29, including any unfinished inner operation, is excluded from both windows.
